name: smwmusic-kirby-the-amazing-mirror-rainbow-route
title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror - Rainbow Route
description:
Originally when I finished a rough draft of this, I thought it felt empty.
....So I did some more work on it and it became something else.


This is not an accurate port.


Anyways... This is the happy song you hear in Rainbow Route in Kirby & the Amazing Mirror.

This song would fit anything that's happy.
Grasslands, outskirts of a happy town, a grassy level 1, a forest, things like that.

Anything that you can use the vanilla "Here we go!" for would probably work with this.
But this works with more than "Here we go!", so keep that in mind.
